title: The single-flight claim (running, waiting, paying) and the owed pay should be their own type that owns its state privately, so AppleHealthSync is split by ownership, not by line count
evidence: PR 1288 moved erased/deleteOwed/pay/drained to ios/HealthRoadmap/Health/AppleHealthSync+Owed.swift as an extension to pass the 500-line ratchet; Swift's per-file private forced store, client, memory, running, waiting, paying, disconnect(), deleteOwed and drained to internal (each marked // internal only for AppleHealthSync+Owed.swift). A type owning the claim and the pay would make them private again. H27 (PR 1694) replaced `running` with the private(set) Run union `run` (AppleHealthSync.swift:46; AppleHealthRun.swift:10-79, transition :21); waiting (:64), paying (:69), store (:55), client (:57), memory (:58), disconnect() (:280), deleteOwed (AppleHealthSync+Owed.swift:50) and drained (:92) are still internal for the +Owed extension: the owning type is still to do.
